title: Luke's first lesson
description: On Yavin 4, anxious Rebels retrieve the Death Star technical readouts provided by R2-D2 and use them to plan a daring attack. Luke Skywalker prepares for the battle of his life, donning the gear of a star pilot. He is greatly disappointed when Han Solo decides to bow out of the upcoming fight, choosing to claim his reward for rescuing Leia rather than join the Rebel cause. A kiss from the princess sends Luke on his way, and soon he and his fellow starfighter pilots are off on their fateful mission...with the fate of the galaxy hanging in the balance...
